name: @speedora/clip-ranking
description: Stateless module (JSON-in/JSON-out): AI Intelligence v4 Phase 14.1 (Clip Ranking Engine, Stage D) - composes 12 dimensions (Fusion, Virality, Narrative, Hook, Retention, Semantic Importance, and the 6 ClipScores dimensions) over a batch of already-rendered clips into one final rank. Scoring only - does not decide when to run or how to assemble its own input, see docs/ai/clip-ranking-engine.md's Phase 14.2. No DB/queue access at all; see root ARCHITECTURE.md.
